agent.layout.title: Layout
agent.layout.short: Decides where the streamer's webcam and the game go in the vertical clip.
agent.layout.does: SMTV first finds the streamer's webcam on the clip's frames by itself, on your computer, and remembers it for the other clips of the recording. This step is asked only when that is unclear (no face, two webcams, a camera hidden behind an avatar): it looks at five frames and chooses the 9:16 layout, so the streamer's webcam stays in the frame. When it is unsure itself, it is asked twice more and the answers are put to a vote.
agent.layout.needs: five frames and the clip's words
agent.layout.why: Medium with images: it has to see where the webcam and the game are.
agent.banner.title: Ad banner
agent.banner.short: Finds sponsor ads in the frame, so they can be blurred.
agent.banner.does: Finds sponsor logos and ad overlays on five frames spread over the recording, once per recording, so they can be blurred in every clip and in the recap.
agent.banner.why: Medium with images: it looks for a logo on the frame.
agent.critic.title: Critic
agent.critic.short: Checks each finished clip like an editor and fixes it if needed.
agent.critic.does: Looks at frames of the finished clips like an editor, a few clips at a time: the webcam in its place, the face not covered by the hook or the captions, the layout right, no black bars. Asks for at most one edit per clip (another layout, captions higher or lower, no hook) and checks that clip again; the better version stays. Only with «Critic» on.
agent.critic.needs: four to six frames of each finished clip and a few lines about it
agent.critic.why: Medium with images: it judges what a viewer sees on a phone; production runs it on a medium model.
set_broken: The settings file was damaged, so SMTV started with clean settings. The old file is kept as {file}. Connect the AI again in Settings.
